title: What is the Added Value of UDA in the VFM Era?
mechanism: Measures that the UDA gain over source-only VFM fine-tuning shrinks from +8 to +2 mIoU with stronger source data, and is zero with diverse real source data.
adaptation: Use as a prior for E1. If a VFM backbone is adopted, expect target-pool UDA to add little, so run MIC on the house model first. For the benchmark, report source-only VFM fine-tuning as the E1 baseline.
min_experiment: No separate run. Read it with MIC-E1: if MIC helps the R34 house model, repeat on the VFM model; kill VFM-UDA if the gain is under +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
evidence: R: synthetic->real UDA gain +8 -> +2 mIoU with stronger source data; 0 with diverse real source; with 1/16 Cityscapes labels, synthetic UDA reaches 85 mIoU, matching full supervision.
